targets:jezero:5.name: Measured by pipeline/prep_tes.py from MGS TES Standard Data Products, TARGET_TEMPERATURE of surface observations with Clear Atmosphere and Highest Spectral Quality, queried with the TES Data Tool (ASU TES Data Node; archive: PDS Geosciences Node): daytime mean over a 111.2 km patch centred 18.4°N, 77.5°E, 13:20-14:46 local time (2427 spots, 51 passes averaged first). Compared with Earth's daytime value at about 10:30 local time (MODIS Terra), so Mars is measured about 3.5 hours later in its day. No clear-sky passes at Ls 210-240, 240-270 (dusty season). Accessed 2026-11-14.

metrics.desc: Mean surface temperature (average of day and night)

metrics.desc: Daytime surface temperature (about 10:30 local time on Earth)

earth.name: Earth
earth.summary: Home planet. Blue markers are analog sites for studying the Moon and Mars.

moon.name: Moon
moon.summary: No atmosphere. Amber markers are candidate sites.

mars.name: Mars
mars.summary: Thin CO₂ atmosphere. Amber markers are candidate sites.

facts.label: Surface pressure
facts.value: 6.36 mb at mean radius (4.0 to 8.7 mb by season) (NASA Mars Fact Sheet)

sites.name: Shackleton Crater
sites.summary: Crater at the lunar south pole with permanently shadowed ground where water ice may be trapped.
sites.coord_src: Site marker carried over from the original dataset. Not yet checked against a gazetteer.

analogs.why: Both are polar impact craters with ice and extreme cold, good for testing drilling and logistics.
Cold, dry polar regolith with ground ice.

sites.name: Tranquility Base
sites.summary: Apollo 11 landing site on a flat basaltic mare.
sites.coord_src: Apollo 11 landing site 0.67° N, 23.47° E (NASA NSSDC Apollo 11 page, https://nssdc.gsfc.nasa.gov/planetary/lunar/apollo11info.html).

analogs.why: Fresh basalt flows and cinder fields resemble mare basalt terrain.
Basaltic volcanic ground, used for regolith and rover trials.

sites.name: Jezero Crater
sites.summary: Crater with an ancient river delta and lakebed; Perseverance rover landing site.
sites.coord_src: Site marker carried over from the original dataset. Not yet checked against a gazetteer.

analogs.why: Hyper-arid ancient lakebeds and salts, a standard biosignature-hunting analog.
Cold hyper-arid desert with ground ice.
